captions.detailed: This 3D model features a carillon bell tower constructed with a tall, square stone-colored shaft and an open belfry stage near the top. Inside the open-air belfry, five golden-bronze bells of varying sizes are suspended from horizontal wooden support beams. The tower is capped with a dark, conical roof. Each of the five bells is articulated with its own revolute joint, allowing them to swing independently along their individual horizontal axes.
captions.instruction: Generate a carillon bell tower with a square stone shaft, an open-air belfry, and five bronze-colored bells of different sizes suspended from wooden headstocks. Each bell should be connected via a revolute joint to swing independently around its horizontal axis.
captions.factory: The code constructs the main tower base using a series of stacked boxes to create a stepped stone shaft, topped with four corner pillars for the open belfry and a conical roof. The internal belfry structure is built from wooden-colored rectangular beams. Five individual bell parts are modeled using a combination of cylinder and sphere primitives to form the classic bell shape. These bells are positioned at intervals along the support beams and connected to the main tower frame using five distinct revolute articulations with horizontal rotation axes.
